text: dsh-openrouter-sync 是一个面向 DSH host 的 OpenRouter 模型列表同步插件，通过 bundle 挂载到活动 profile，并每六小时查询 OpenRouter 的模型目录。它筛选免费、支持 tools 且上下文长度至少 64K（若服务端有提供）的模型，按上下文长度排序后更新 openrouter provider 的 models 列表，同时写入刷新状态快照。配置变更可由 DSH HMR 重新组合。适合希望减少手动维护免费模型清单的 DSH 用户。同步需要 OPENROUTER_API_KEY；模型目录请求会发送到 OpenRouter。

dsh-openrouter-sync keeps a DSH profile's OpenRouter model list current. Every six hours it fetches the catalog, selects free tool-capable models with at least 64K context when specified, sorts them, and updates the profile. Sync needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY and contacts OpenRouter.
想让 DSH 自动更新 OpenRouter 上免费的模型列表。
OpenRouter 的免费模型经常变化，有没有办法同步到我的 DSH 配置里？
How can I keep DSH's OpenRouter provider list current with free tool-capable models?
dsh-openrouter-sync 的功能「定时同步免费模型」：插件每六小时读取 OpenRouter 模型目录，筛选免费且支持 tools 的模型并排序后更新 profile 中 openrouter 的 models 列表。
dsh-openrouter-sync 的功能「记录同步状态」：同步后把时间、profile 和结果写入 DSH cache 下的 openrouter-sync.json，便于查看最近刷新状态。
同步会携带 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 请求 OpenRouter 模型目录；密钥从凭据服务、进程环境或本机凭据文件读取，未找到密钥时会跳过同步。

dsh-openrouter-sync README · dsh-openrouter-sync：Keep the DSH `openrouter` provider model list in sync with OpenRouter's currently-free models.

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin,
packaged as a DSH bundle: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `openrouter-sync` row into the active profile.
Host-only plugin: every six hours it rewrites the `openrouter` provider models in the active profile patch; HMR recomposes it live.

dsh-openrouter-sync README · Install：- Desktop app: **Plugins** → install `github:bosenok/dsh-openrouter-sync` (private repository:
  give the machine git access), then enable the bundle.
- CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:bosenok/dsh-openrouter-sync`.
- Local checkout: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:/path/to/dsh-openrouter-sync`.

Enabling the bundle mounts the plugin; HMR applies it to a running app, and a
restart makes sure the client half is rebuilt.

dsh-openrouter-sync README · Install：> Note for the app-managed `desktop` profile: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add`
> only installs the dependency and copies the package; unlike a regular profile
> it does not enable the bundle. Enable it by adding the package name to
> `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (or through the
> Plugins page). Other profiles enable the installed bundle automatically.

dsh-openrouter-sync README · Where the key comes from：The host half resolves `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` through the harness credential
service first, then the process environment, then
`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`; with no key it still lists the provider's models only
when configured — the sync itself is skipped. Nothing plugin-specific to set up
beyond the OpenRouter provider (or an `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` entry in the
credential store / environment layers).

dsh-openrouter-sync README · Versioning：This project follows [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/) (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`).
Releases are tagged in git (`v0.1.0` and later `v0.1.x` tags), announced
as GitHub releases and documented in [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md).

`engines.dsh` in `package.json` pins the compatible DSH range.

Bump policy: **patch** — fixes; **minor** — new features without breaking the
configuration; **major** — breaking changes to the configuration, the session
format or the supported DSH range.

dsh-openrouter-sync README · Versioning：`CHANGELOG.md` is generated with [git-cliff](https://git-cliff.org/) from
[Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`cliff.toml`):

```sh
./scripts/changelog.sh                 # print unreleased notes
./scripts/changelog.sh v0.2.0          # add the next release section
git cliff -o CHANGELOG.md              # full regeneration (curated history is kept otherwise)
```

To install a specific release instead of a moving branch, pin the tag:

dsh-openrouter-sync README · Versioning：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+ssh://git@github.com/bosenok/dsh-openrouter-sync.git#v0.1.0"
```

Tags are created on `master` by Git Flow; integration builds live on `develop`
(install with `#develop` if you want the latest unreleased code).

dsh-openrouter-sync README · Development：`lib/` is built and committed; the sources live in `src/`. Rebuild the client with
the repository's Vite config (`npx vite build` → `dist/`, then the wrapper in
`build/wrapper.js` produces `lib/client.js`).

dsh-openrouter-sync README · License：MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Third-party code bundled into `lib/` and its
licenses are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

dsh-openrouter-sync README · Git Flow：Development follows [Git Flow](https://github.com/git-flow/git-flow-next) via the
committable `.gitflow` configuration. In a fresh clone activate it once:

```sh
./scripts/gitflow-setup.sh
```

(The script runs `git flow config sync` and creates the local `master`/`develop`
branches. `git flow config sync` alone is enough if both base branches already
exist.)

dsh-openrouter-sync README · Git Flow：| Branch | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `master` | released code only; every commit here is tagged `vX.Y.Z` |
| `develop` | integration branch (repository default branch) |
| `feature/*` | one change, started from and finished into `develop` |
| `release/*` | stabilization, started from `develop`, finished into `master` + `develop` |
| `hotfix/*` | urgent production fix, started from `master`, finished into both |
